data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 reported a net prior-year surplus of GBP 9.6m in 2018, representing a release of prior reserves. The reported prior-year improvement was largely driven by favorable development and the final settlement of a long-running court case relating to the World Trade Center attack (2001), which accounted for the bulk of releases. 2018 catastrophe activity (notably US Hurricane Michael and California wildfires) had limited direct impact on prior-year development for this syndicate.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 9.6m (2017: GBP 3.7m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

This result, achieved in very difficult market conditions, was significantly boosted by improvements in losses on prior years of account, resulting in releases totalling GBP 4.6m. The vast bulk of these releases were due to the final settlement of a court case relating to the terrorist attack on the World Trade Center in 2001.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (insurance-liabilities) was not explicitly stated. The report explicitly states a net prior-year surplus of GBP 9.6m; per extraction rules the gross figure was not available so the net figure was used as a fallback and is reported here (flagged). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet prior-year comparative column. A gross claims development triangle is present but contains an '2010 and prior' aggregate column and some rows with missing cells, complicating robust gross PYD calculation; therefore net fallback was used.
